title: AI-DLC automatic session handoff settings
description: Settings of the ai-dlc plugin's automatic session handoff (Claude Code only), committed in .ai-dlc/auto-handoff.json. Each key is read, highest first, from the env of .claude/settings.local.json (its x-env variable), the env of .claude/settings.json, the process environment, this file, the plugin's /config option (keys that have one), then the default. null means not set here: the next source applies. An invalid value is logged and the next source applies. Keys marked x-trustGated apply from this file only when Claude Code trusts the folder (projects[<repository root>].hasTrustDialogAccepted in ~/.claude.json); elsewhere they are ignored and logged.

enabled.description: false turns automatic handoffs off. Claude Code's own DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT also turns them off.

thresholdPercent.description: Share of the context window, 1 to 100, at which the main session hands off. The window is the one Claude Code reports, else defaultContextWindow. thresholdTokens, when set, replaces it.

thresholdTokens.description: An absolute handoff line in tokens, replacing thresholdPercent. Use it when Claude Code reports no window and yours is smaller than the percentage line, or for a test run. Unset by default.

defaultContextWindow.description: The context window in tokens that thresholdPercent applies to when Claude Code reports none.

seedHeadroomTokens.description: A seeded session hands off no sooner than this many tokens above its own starting size, so it can read its handoff and still do work.

maxConsecutiveHandoffs.description: Handoffs allowed in a row before you type a prompt, when no AI-DLC run is active for the chain. With an active run, chainWhileRunActive decides.

chainWhileRunActive.description: true: while the AI-DLC run the chain hands off stays active, the chain goes on past maxConsecutiveHandoffs, and it ends when the run is done, blocked or abandoned. false: maxConsecutiveHandoffs always applies.

renameSessions.description: Name the sessions of a chain "<sessionNamePrefix>: <original name> (Session N)". The original session is renamed Session 1 with /rename when the running Claude Code has it.

sessionNamePrefix.description: The prefix of the chain's session names.

briefTemplate.description: Markdown file that tells Haiku which sections to write when no AI-DLC run is active (with one, the handoff skill's session handoff template is used). Created with the defaults on first run. From this file it applies only when Claude Code trusts the folder.

instructionsTemplate.description: Markdown file that tells the fresh session how to read the brief. Created with the defaults on first run. From this file it applies only when Claude Code trusts the folder.

ignoreFiles.description: A regular expression: edited files matching it are left out of the brief. "" means none.

viewer.description: Where to serve a readable page for each brief, as host:port, the port 10 to 65535; "tailscale" as the host means this machine's Tailscale IP. "" means no server. From this file it applies only when Claude Code trusts the folder.
